caption: The drawing features three depictions of a woman's head, each showcasing a large, wide-brimmed hat. All three hats are a light tan or beige color with lavender and pink accents. The hat on the upper left has a wide brim with a light purple striped underside, adorned with a large, textured pink-and-lavender plume or flower and a purple ribbon near the crown. The hat in the center is viewed from the back, shows the same tan color with a purple ribbon tied in a bow and lavender decorative feathers or plumes extending from one side. The hat at the bottom left, which is seen from a front angle, features a similarly wide brim with a lavender striped underside, a purple ribbon wrapped around the crown and tied at the side, along with a pink decorative element. The faces shown have red lips and fair complexions, with visible brown hair styled in soft curls under the hats. The drawing style uses black lines for outlines and soft pastel shades for color, and the hats are the central focus in each depiction. The artist's name, "Lillian Causey," is written in small text at the bottom right of the image. The background is a plain off-white or light beige.
title: Bonnet
